Arya Satya
Andhika Akbar
site.role: My Life Story, an unfinished personality

info.label: Interests
info.text: Art direction, mostly animation and illustration. I love Acoustic guitar. Space and whatever is out there beyond us. And the technology that supports it.

info.label: Tools
info.text: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. p5.js for the stars, Three.js for the moon, GSAP for the motion, Google Fonts for the type. Hosted on GitHub Pages.

info.label: About
info.text: I'm an Information Systems student who keeps drifting between code and art. This site is where those two sides meet. It's unfinished on purpose, I keep changing it as I change.

contactNote: Open for collaborations, internships and random art talk. Email is the fastest way to reach me.

faq.a: A personal collection of what I make and learn, so I can see how I've changed over time. Mostly it's for me, but you're welcome to look around.

faq.q: How long have you been making this website?
faq.a: Since 2024, and I'm still working on it. It's an unfinished collection, so it keeps growing as I do.

faq.q: Are there any websites that inspired you?
faq.a: A few: gather.be-of-dao.com, v1.kentatoshikura.com, shutdown.gallery, infocusinc.com, production-hasu.work and p5aholic.me. I'm not copying them, I just borrow the feeling.

faq.q: When did you start doing art?
faq.a: Around 2014 or 2015, so it's been about ten years now.
